description: This file implements cryptography hash functions (MD5, SHA-1, MD4) for the Crypto Object, including functions to compute these hashes and return a hash value modulo a specified size. It includes the specific functions AnscCryptoHashMd5, AnscCryptoHashSha1, and AnscCryptoHashMd4, which utilize underlying digest functions.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoHashMd5(PVOID buffer,ULONG size,ULONG modulus)
methods.description: Computes the MD5 hash of input data and returns a value modulo the specified size.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoHashSha1(PVOID buffer,ULONG size,ULONG modulus)
methods.description: Computes the SHA-1 hash of input data and returns a value modulo the specified size.

methods.name: ULONG AnscCryptoHashMd4(PVOID buffer,ULONG size,ULONG modulus)
methods.description: Computes the MD4 hash of input data and returns a value modulo the specified size.
